topic.title: Complementarity of compact statistics and grouped history evidence
topic.question: Do count/freshness statistics add predictive utility to match-group history evidence beyond either source alone, after controlling for capacity, redundancy, and measured cost?
topic.hypothesis: The full-mean versus scalar-only result suggests representation matters within the compact-evidence branch, but does not establish compatibility with match groups. Count/freshness evidence may complement grouped readout; failure to exceed the stronger frozen source under matched-capacity and redundancy controls would leave this complementarity unsupported.
